All fields share the field tokens of the code (`getFieldTokens`): one outlined box, a floating label on its top border, helper text below.

## Markup
```html
<!-- TextField -->
<div class="rp-text-field">
  <label class="rp-field-label rp-field-label-required" for="email">Email</label>
  <div class="rp-field-box"><input class="rp-field-input" id="email" type="email" value="gregor.samsa@coastalhotels.com" /></div>
  <span class="rp-field-helper">We send the invitation to this address</span>
</div>

<!-- Select (single). Options are buttons; the selected one has rp-menu-item-selected -->
<div class="rp-select rp-select-size-small" data-rp-placeholder="Select">
  <span class="rp-field-label">Role</span>
  <button type="button" class="rp-field-box rp-select-trigger" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Role"><span class="rp-select-value">Analyst</span></button>
  <div class="rp-menu" role="listbox">
    <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item" role="option" aria-selected="false">Administrator</button>
    <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item rp-menu-item-selected" role="option" aria-selected="true">Analyst</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Select (multiple): rp-select-multiple + a checkbox glyph in each option -->
<div class="rp-select rp-select-multiple" data-rp-all-text="All establishments">
  <span class="rp-field-label">Establishments</span>
  <button type="button" class="rp-field-box rp-select-trigger" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Establishments"><span class="rp-select-value">Grand Marina Resort &amp; Spa</span></button>
  <div class="rp-menu" role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true">
    <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item rp-menu-item-selected" role="option" aria-selected="true"><span class="rp-checkbox-glyph"></span>Grand Marina Resort &amp; Spa</button>
    <button type="button" class="rp-menu-item" role="option" aria-selected="false"><span class="rp-checkbox-glyph"></span>Azure Bay Hotel</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Search (filters a table with data-rp-filter="tableId") -->
<div class="rp-search rp-search-size-small" data-rp-filter="usersTable">
  <div class="rp-field-box"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-search"></span><input class="rp-field-input" type="search" placeholder="Search by name or email" aria-label="Search" /><button type="button" class="rp-icon-button rp-icon-button-size-small rp-search-clear" aria-label="Clear search"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-close"></span></button></div>
</div>

<!-- TextArea with counter (data-rp-max) -->
<div class="rp-text-area rp-text-area-full-width" data-rp-max="500">
  <label class="rp-field-label">Signature text</label>
  <div class="rp-field-box"><textarea class="rp-field-input" rows="4" aria-label="Signature text"></textarea></div>
  <span class="rp-field-helper rp-text-area-counter"><span>Shown at the end of every reply</span><span class="rp-text-area-count">0/500</span></span>
</div>

<!-- DatePicker: a field with a calendar icon; opens a menu of presets -->
<div class="rp-date-picker rp-date-picker-size-small">
  <span class="rp-field-label">Stay date</span>
  <button type="button" class="rp-field-box" data-rp-menu="dateMenu" aria-label="Stay date"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-calendar"></span><span data-rp-menu-label>01/03/2026 - 31/03/2026</span></button>
</div>
```

## States
`{root}-error` (helper text = the message, in red), `{root}-warning`, `{root}-disabled`, `{root}-size-small` (40px, the size for toolbars and tables), `{root}-full-width`. Inline select for footers: `rp-select-inline`.

## Behavior (shared.js)
- Selects open, pick, close, filter with `.rp-menu-search`, keep `aria-*` in sync and fire `change` on `.rp-select`.
- Filters: `data-rp-filter="tableId"` on a search or a select (+ `data-rp-filter-column="2"` for the column, `data-rp-filter-all="All roles"` for the option that means no filter).
- Validation: a label with `rp-field-label-required` makes the field required for `data-rp-validate` (message "{Label} is required").
- Assistive tech: the same label makes shared.js add `aria-required="true"` to the input (and ", required" to a select's accessible name), like MUI's `required` prop. Nothing to add by hand.

## Rules
- Every form field has a label. A placeholder never replaces it.
- Width comes from the layout (`kit-form` columns or `-full-width`), never from inline widths inside forms. Toolbar fields may set a width with `style="width: 220px"`.
- Never a native `<select>`.
- Error messages: one sentence, sentence case, no period ("Email is required").

## Slider
Figma Slider: label, start value, the range input, end value. `data-rp-slider-value="{v}%"` on the end value shows the current value; shared.js fills the track.
```html
<div class="rp-slider"><span class="rp-slider-label">Minimum score</span>
  <div class="rp-slider-row"><span>0</span><input type="range" class="rp-slider-input" min="0" max="100" value="70" aria-label="Minimum score" /><span data-rp-slider-value="{v}%">70%</span></div></div>
```
## Uploader
Figma Uploader: a dashed drop zone with an Upload file ghost button, a hint and the accepted files. The hidden file input covers the zone; shared.js lists the chosen files (names only, nothing is uploaded). `rp-uploader-error` + an `rp-field-helper` below for an error; `rp-uploader-disabled`.
```html
<div class="rp-uploader"><div class="rp-uploader-zone"><input type="file" aria-label="Upload file" />
  <span class="rp-ghost-button rp-ghost-button-size-medium"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-upload"></span>Upload file</span>
  <div class="rp-uploader-text"><span class="rp-uploader-hint">Or drag and drop files here to upload</span><span class="rp-uploader-help">You can upload your file (JPG/PNG/GIF) up to 20MB.</span></div></div></div>
```
